title: The Bright Terminal
author: Kestrel Nakamura
blurb: Freya Lockridge, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the jump window closes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
